method: Two exact independently admitted FPV Learning distributions, same local Mac/browser/viewport/settings and identical frozen passive observer. Separate fresh browser profiles; ordinary trusted controls; first accepted 20-second sample per scenario. Raw reports preserve rejected attempts. No progress injection.
limitations: A single accepted sample per case does not establish statistical confidence or general responsiveness.
Stationary active play does not represent sustained player input; routes and final scores differed in the normal-win samples.
Page-wide long tasks do not isolate reward-rendering time. Detached owners, object URLs and decoder retention remain unverified.
Neither report establishes installation, physical-device, human review or publication qualification.
The current CI run completed checks, compilation and upload but ended cancelled at its job time limit; these desktop observations do not override that conclusion.
